description: Catalog of paste-ready premium composition patterns that score 9-10/10 on the tac-ui-rubric. Use this skill when designing or building any user-facing surface — landing hero, KPI dashboard, data table, status timeline, scan card, drawer, command palette, empty state, error boundary. Each pattern is fully tokenized (Violet Grid v6), has an animation spec, defines its loading/empty/error states, and includes file:line precedents from the existing codebase. Trigger on "build a hero", "make this card premium", "design a KPI tile", "lay out this dashboard page", "polish this section", "I need a premium [X]".
